title: Meet the Rabbit
description: Examine the Rabbit and follow it to the library

story: You see a Rabbit, a piece of paper, and a rabbithole.
Eleanor: "Let's listen to what the Rabbit has to say."
hints: Use 'cat Rabbit' to listen to the Rabbit.

story: The Rabbit doesn't say anything. That's quite normal for rabbits.
Eleanor: "Maybe the note will tell us something?"
hints: Use 'cat note' to examine the note.

story: The note says: 'The Super User command is kept in ~/town/east/library'
Eleanor: "The library! That's where we found the VI command."
"Let's go there. It looks like the Rabbit will follow us."
hints: Use 'cd ~/town/east/library' to go to the library.
